subject: general
question: Saga Dawa celebrated by Buddhist communities falls between which two months?
solution:
The correct answer is __**May and June**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Saga Dawa is a significant festival celebrated by Buddhist communities, particularly in Tibet, Bhutan, and Nepal.
 
• The festival commemorates the birth, enlightenment, and death (parinirvana) of Gautama Buddha.
 
• Saga Dawa falls in the fourth month of the Tibetan lunar calendar, typically between May and June in the Gregorian calendar.
 
• It is considered one of the most sacred months in the Buddhist calendar, with many devotees engaging in acts of kindness, pilgrimages, and prayers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vesak (Buddha Purnima)**

 
 
• Vesak, also known as Buddha Purnima, is another major Buddhist festival that marks the birth, enlightenment, and death of Buddha.
 
• It is celebrated on the full moon day in the month of Vaishakha (April/May).
 
 
 
• **Significance of Saga Dawa**
 
 
• Saga Dawa is believed to multiply the merits of good deeds performed during this month many times over.
 
• Devotees often engage in activities such as almsgiving, freeing animals, and reciting prayers.
 
 
 
• **Traditional Practices**
 
 
• Many Buddhists go on pilgrimages to sacred sites, such as Mount Kailash, during Saga Dawa.
 
• Lhasa, the capital of Tibet, sees a significant increase in religious activities, with devotees circumambulating the Potala Palace and other holy sites.
 
 
 
• **Saga Dawa Duchen**
 
 
• The full moon day of Saga Dawa is known as Saga Dawa Duchen, one of the most important days of the festival.
 
• It is believed that the Buddha's birth, enlightenment, and death all occurred on this auspicious day.
